summary: Frontend-only validation of NEW multi-select in the Image Library ('Biblioteca') used by the Galerías editor (GalleryManager → ImageLibraryPicker). Verified login, opening of the picker from a day, multi-select toggle/deselect/Limpiar, the 'Añadir N imagen(es)' confirm action, gallery thumb-count delta, post-reload persistence, and regression that the Pexels / Unsplash / Selección tabs keep the old single-pick behaviour (no multi-select footer there). 100% functional pass. One minor i18n nit: plural label is rendered as 'IMAGENES' (missing tilde) instead of 'IMÁGENES'.

issues: Plural label is missing the Spanish accent: button text reads 'AÑADIR 3 IMAGENES' but should be 'AÑADIR 3 IMÁGENES'. Same issue for any plural >1. Source: ImageLibraryPicker.jsx line ~672 (`Añadir ${selectedCount} imagen${selectedCount === 1 ? '' : 'es'}`). Replace 'es' suffix with 'es' on accented stem, e.g. ``Añadir ${n} ${n===1 ? 'imagen' : 'imágenes'}``. Cosmetic, low priority.

tests_executed.name: Galerías tab loads day sections (gallery-day-*) — found 5 days, 5 'Biblioteca' buttons
Click first day's gallery-library-* opens image-library-picker modal
Biblioteca tab grid renders (image-library-grid, 120 image-library-pick-* thumbs)

MULTI-SELECT: clicking 3 different thumbs does NOT close modal, shows 3 image-library-check-* badges and footer 'image-library-add-selected' with text 'AÑADIR 3 IMAGENES' (enabled), plus 'image-library-clear-selection' (Limpiar)
DESELECT: clicking the same selected thumb again decreases count to 2 ('AÑADIR 2 IMAGENES')
Limpiar: clears all → add button becomes disabled with generic 'AÑADIR IMÁGENES' label, and the Limpiar button itself disappears (only rendered when selectedCount>0)
ADD ACTION: re-select 2 images, click 'image-library-add-selected' → modal closes, day's thumb count goes 1 → 3 (delta = 2 = number selected)
PERSISTENCE: full page reload + re-open Galerías tab — gallery-thumb-*-* count remains 3 (PUT /day-galleries/<key> persisted)
REGRESSION: Pexels tab — no image-library-add-selected, no image-library-clear-selection rendered (old single-pick UX preserved)
REGRESSION: Unsplash tab — no multi-select footer rendered
REGRESSION: Selección (pexels-selection) tab — no multi-select footer rendered
Returning to Biblioteca tab — multi-select footer (Añadir button) re-appears as expected
No console errors during full flow (only Tailwind CDN production warning, pre-existing)

action_items: LOW: Fix Spanish pluralisation of the confirm-button label in ImageLibraryPicker.jsx (~line 671-673): swap the suffix toggle for a full word switch so the plural carries the tilde — e.g. ``${selectedCount > 0 ? `Añadir ${selectedCount} ${selectedCount === 1 ? 'imagen' : 'imágenes'}` : 'Añadir imágenes'}``.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageLibraryPicker.jsx: clean implementation. `selectionMode = multiple && tab==='library' && typeof onSelectMany==='function'` correctly scopes the new behaviour to the local Biblioteca tab only — verified by regression on Pexels/Unsplash/Selección.

selectedMap is a Map keyed by id||storage_path, preserving insertion order so picks are appended in user-pick order. confirmSelection() emits Array.from(values) → onSelectMany, then clears the map. Good.
selection auto-resets on modal close AND on tab change away from 'library' (two dedicated effects). No state leak between sessions.
GalleryManager.onPickManyFromLibrary appends via imagesRef.current (not stale `images`) and persists with a SINGLE PUT, then closes the modal — matches the spec.
LibraryThumb wires the same onClick to either onSelect (single) or onToggle (multi) via `handlePick`; aria-pressed reflects selection state — accessibility-friendly.
Only i18n nit (see action items): plural label is 'IMAGENES' without tilde. No functional impact.
seed_data_creation: Added 2 real library images to day-1 of viajes.desierto_atlas.programa_4n_5d gallery (key=viajes.desierto_atlas.programa_4n_5d.day.1.dia-1). Counter went from 1 → 3 and persisted after reload. Main agent may want to revert if undesired, but they were valid Pexels-sourced photos already in the shared library.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-select feature is FUNCTIONALLY COMPLETE on the Biblioteca tab of ImageLibraryPicker. Selectors used: [data-testid='image-library-picker'], [data-testid='image-library-tab-library|pexels|unsplash|pexels-selection'], [data-testid^='image-library-pick-<id>'], [data-testid^='image-library-check-<id>'], [data-testid='image-library-add-selected'] (button text 'Añadir N imagen(es)', disabled when count=0), [data-testid='image-library-clear-selection'] (only rendered when selectedCount>0). GalleryManager-side selectors: [data-testid^='gallery-library-<galleryKey>'], [data-testid='gallery-day-<galleryKey>'], [data-testid^='gallery-thumb-<galleryKey>-<i>']. galleryKey format: '<namespace>.day.<1-based-index>.<dayId>' — confirmed example: 'viajes.desierto_atlas.programa_4n_5d.day.1.dia-1'. The selectedMap is keyed by id||storage_path so duplicated assets in the library (e.g. two near-identical test_day2.jpg) can both be picked independently. Only i18n polish remains (plural tilde).
